summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A., a Milan-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a binding agreement with Berkshire Hathaway for a private placement of 10 million ordinary shares at $33.00 per share, raising approximately $330 million before expenses, announced October 14, 2026. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and new acquisitions. The placement relies on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exemptions, with customary registration rights for the investor. Closing is subject to customary conditions, expected Q4 2026. This is a routine exempt capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing versus any future listing and use of proceeds for acquisitions.
